matched_search.uncertainty: Random rows show exact search-policy SD conditional on one training seed; other rows are one trajectory; no training-seed CI

vcc_corrected.partition_rule: whole intervention groups; original disjoint train/dev/test roles; train/dev round-robin assignment to ten clients
vcc_corrected.roster_rule: five distinct role-local options; true intervention once, four distractors; frozen shuffled option order
vcc_corrected.aggregation_diagnostic: The ten development panels have equal intervention counts (VCC: two; Tahoe: six): equal-client macro equals pooled intervention macro exactly; query micro is a different estimand.

tahoe_drug_corrected.roster_rule: five distinct role-local options; true intervention once, four distractors; frozen shuffled option order
tahoe_drug_corrected.aggregation_diagnostic: The ten development panels have equal intervention counts (VCC: two; Tahoe: six): equal-client macro equals pooled intervention macro exactly; query micro is a different estimand.

validation.interpretation: Retrospective diagnosis, not a new validation split or causal attribution. Bootstrap intervals do not adjust for selection or model search.

roster.limitation: Post-hoc roster sensitivity of fixed models on the same development interventions; not a new split or causal attribution.

development_prefix.role: descriptive prefix analysis of unchanged sealed policies; no new selections or training
